Lemmatization.lemmatize_sentence:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Removes punctuation from a sentence, tokenizes it, part-of-speech tags each token, and lemmatizes each word using verb, adjective, adverb, or default lemmatization based on the tag prefix." lemmatize_sentence]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> sentence </REF>: string "The input sentence to be cleaned, tokenized, and lemmatized."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> lemmatized_words </REF>: list of strings "The lemmatized forms of the input words, in the same order as the tokenized sentence."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize lemmatized_words as an empty list to hold the lemmatized token results. RESULT lemmatized_words]
            [COMMAND Call self.remove_punctuation(sentence) and overwrite sentence with the punctuation-free returned string. RESULT sentence]
            [COMMAND Tokenize the cleaned sentence by calling word_tokenize(sentence) and store the resulting list as words. RESULT words]
            [COMMAND Part-of-speech tag words by calling pos_tag(words) and store the list of (word, tag) pairs as tagged_words. RESULT tagged_words]
            [COMMAND For each (word, tag) pair in tagged_words, choose the lemmatization mode by checking the tag prefix: if tag starts with 'V' use the verb POS flag 'v'; else if tag starts with 'J' use the adjective POS flag 'a'; else if tag starts with 'R' use the adverb POS flag 'r'; otherwise use the default lemmatization by calling self.lemmatizer.lemmatize(word) without a POS flag. Assign the lemmatized result to lemmatized_word. RESULT lemmatized_word]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over tagged_words, after lemmatized_word has been computed for the current (word, tag), append lemmatized_word to lemmatized_words. RESULT lemmatized_words]
            [COMMAND Return lemmatized_words as the final method result. RESULT lemmatized_words]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Lemmatization.get_pos_tag:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Removes punctuation from a sentence, tokenizes it, performs part-of-speech tagging, and returns a list of POS tags for the tokens." get_pos_tag]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance of the class providing the remove_punctuation method."
        <REF> sentence </REF>: string "Input sentence to be processed."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> pos_tags </REF>: list of strings "List of POS tags corresponding to each token in the cleaned sentence."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize pos_tags as an empty list. RESULT pos_tags]
            [COMMAND Remove punctuation from sentence by calling self.remove_punctuation(sentence) and assign the result back to sentence. RESULT sentence]
            [COMMAND Tokenize the cleaned sentence using word_tokenize(sentence) and assign the result to words. RESULT words]
            [COMMAND Tag the tokenized words with part-of-speech tags by calling pos_tag(words) and assign the result to tagged_words. RESULT tagged_words]
            [COMMAND For each tagged_word in tagged_words, append tagged_word[1] (the POS tag) to pos_tags. RESULT pos_tags]
            [COMMAND Return pos_tags. RESULT pos_tags]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Lemmatization.remove_punctuation:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Removes all ASCII punctuation characters from the input sentence by applying a translation table and returns the cleaned string." remove_punctuation]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> sentence </REF>: str "The input string from which punctuation characters will be removed."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str "A new string with all ASCII punctuation characters removed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a translation table using str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation) so that every punctuation character maps to None for deletion. RESULT translation_table]
            [COMMAND Apply the translation table to sentence using sentence.translate(translation_table) to remove punctuation characters and store the resulting new string. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Return the resulting punctuation-free string. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
